name: Character Rain
tags: matrix rain canvas katakana green falling text effect
note: Canvas column rain where each column keeps its own head position and speed; the head glyph is drawn brighter than the trail, and the whole field fades by overpainting rather than clearing.

name: Typewriter Shell Loop
note: A shell session that types a command character by character, holds, deletes it backwards, then moves to the next. Above it sit two settled history lines so the pane reads as a real session. Block caret blinks on a steps(1) timeline; scanline texture over the body. Reduced motion renders the first command statically with a still caret.

name: Cipher Scramble Resolve
note: Four key/value rows whose values churn through random glyphs and lock in left to right, staggered so the block resolves like a decrypt. Targets are read from the markup at mount, so you edit the text in HTML and the effect follows. A hairline progress bar fills per resolved row, then the whole thing re-runs.

name: Matrix Glyph Rain
note: Columns of glyphs falling in a 104px window. Each column is a duplicated glyph stack translated by exactly -50% to 0 so the loop is seamless, with per-column duration and negative delay set inline. A mask fades the head and tail; a slow scanline drifts across. Characters mutate in matched pairs so the seam never breaks.
html:
STREAM 0x1F4
decode 14.2 kb/s

name: ANSI Shadow Banner
note: A six-row ANSI Shadow wordmark built from block and box-drawing characters, revealed row by row like a boot banner, with a specular sweep passing over it on a loop. Status line under the rule cycles through boot messages beside a blinking underscore. Rows carry white-space:pre so the art never reflows.

name: Monospace Feed Ticker
note: Three monospace bands scrolling at different speeds, the middle one reversed. Each track holds two identical runs and translates exactly -50%, so the loop has no seam. Figures are tabular and re-quote on a 900ms tick, updating both duplicated copies together and flashing green or red with the arrow flipped. Hover pauses all bands.

name: Word-By-Word Decode
note: An intercepted transmission printed one word at a time, each word lifting from a 2px blur as it lands. A live counter tracks words decoded against the total, then the block fades and the next message starts. Reduced motion prints the first message in full and stops.

name: Panic Glitch Block
note: A fault screen with a three-layer RGB-split headline: cyan and magenta copies drift and slice under clip-path while the white base holds. Below, dump lines take random character hits from a corruption pool and snap back, and the whole screen occasionally jolts sideways. Reduced motion leaves a clean, still error panel.

KERNEL PANICKERNEL PANICKERNEL PANIC

name: Seven-Segment Countdown
note: Six real seven-segment digits: each is seven clip-path segments with mitred ends, lit from a 0-9 pattern map and given a drop-shadow bloom so unlit strokes still ghost. Colon pips blink on the second; under a minute the display turns red and the status flashes FINAL. Segment order in the markup is a-g, so JS maps by index with no data attributes.
html:

HRSMINSEC
